items.title: RaccoonO365 Phishing Network Shut Down After Microsoft and Cloudflare Disrupt 338 Domains
items.description: Microsoft's Digital Crimes Unit said it teamed up with Cloudflare to coordinate the seizure of 338 domains used by RaccoonO365, a financially motivated threat group that was behind a phishing-as-a-service (Phaas) toolkit used to steal more than 5,000 Microsoft 365 credentials from 94 countries since July 2024. items.title: North Korean Group Targets South With Military ID Deepfakes
items.description: The North Korea-linked group Kimsuky used ChatGPT to create deepfakes of military ID documents in an attempt to compromise South Korean targets.

items.title: Ray Security Takes an Active Data Security Approach
items.description: A data security platform based on action is what the industry needs right now to protect enterprise data.

items.title: ZDI-CAN-27788: PDF-XChange
items.description: A CVSS score 7.3 AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H severity vulnerability discovered by 'Kolja Grassmann (Neodyme AG)' was reported to the affected vendor on: 2025-09-16, 0 days ago. The vendor is given until 2026-01-14 to publish a fix or workaround. Once the vendor has created and tested a patch we will coordinate the release of a public advisory.
